claim_boundary: IR + cost model + validation. No real transport, no FPGA board, no discrete GPU, no bitstream, no interconnect measurement. Every cost is labeled COST_MODEL. HARDWARE_MEASURED is refused at Cost construction.
hardware_measurement: none. No measured hardware claim is produced anywhere in this lane.
rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

roadmap.15.8: Semantic transport / HawkFrame payload semantics and in-transit transform vocabulary
roadmap.15.9: Persistent token pipeline named as NOT IMPLEMENTED (token_id is metadata only)
roadmap.15.10: HawkingHWIR: FPGA_HBM placements lower onto existing dma-transport nodes
roadmap.16.1: PRESENT != VALID != TRUSTED; READBACK CORRECTNESS DOES NOT PROVE DEVICE-COMPUTE VISIBILITY
roadmap.16.2: Coherency ladder 0-6 plus explicit NONE; never claim rung 6 across domains
roadmap.17.1: Fusion law: indifferent to which qualified domain owns an object, with explicit cost/version/trust
roadmap.IV-E: Fusion Bridge / Topology Ascension gene card; this lane instantiates the IR, not DMA hardware

hcli/physical_graph.py.provided: Provider-neutral PhysicalGraph (computation/data/representation/memory/residency/state/precision/dependencies/device_placement/synchronization). compile_physical_graph emits PLAN_ONLY graphs. apply_architecture_atlas projects atlas primitives including SemanticTransportEdge by name. score_physical_candidates ranks measured complete useful work. NOT a typed inter-domain transport edge and NOT a coherency validator.
hcli/physical_graph.py.touched: READ only. overlay_physical_graph copies a compiled dict and fills device_placement/synchronization/dependencies.

tools/odyssey/physical_graph_compiler.py.provided: Source graph -> organ graph -> physical operator graph, with numerical collapse checks (gate_up_swiglu, router top-k). Transformation DAG records cost_delta per stage.
tools/odyssey/physical_graph_compiler.py.added: attach_heterogeneous_plan() appends a heterogeneous_fusion_bridge DAG stage whose cost_delta.label is COST_MODEL. main() and organ-collapse measurements are unchanged.

tools/accelerator/fusion_planner.py.provided: Topology/Link/Route (store-and-forward Dijkstra), object-home Placement (identity, home, replicas, reason), place_objects (mutable vs immutable, organ vs tensor), plan_dependency (MOVE_DATA/MOVE_COMPUTE/RECOMPUTE/REPACK/REPLICATE/WAIT/PREFETCH), collectives. Costs stamped MEASURED/SIMULATED from hop.physical.
tools/accelerator/fusion_planner.py.connected: lift_object_placements wraps place_objects into node Placement (STORAGE). cost_from_route wraps Route and relabels COST_MODEL; planner MEASURED becomes all_hops_physical, never HARDWARE_MEASURED. Topology is reused for the declared host-GPU_UMA <-> FPGA_HBM interconnect. fusion_planner.Placement is object-home placement; it is not replaced.

tools/accelerator/fusion_isa.py.provided: Fourteen-command ISA (ACQUIRE_READ/WRITE, RELEASE, PREFETCH, COPY, MATERIALIZE, INVALIDATE, REDUCE, SCATTER, GATHER, SUBMIT, FENCE, DIGEST, EVICT) and FusionTimeline bookkeeping. No vendor launch API.
tools/accelerator/fusion_isa.py.connected: plan_to_timeline emits ACQUIRE + COPY + FENCE + RELEASE per transport edge and SUBMIT per COMPUTATION placement. No new opcodes.

tools/accelerator/fusion_wire.py.provided: 42-byte command header, no payload, no real transport.
tools/accelerator/fusion_wire.py.connected: Not reimplemented. ISA commands already round-trip through it.

tools/accelerator/humf.py / hmf.py.provided: State/Ownership/MemoryClass, Domain, move-vs-recompute, trust, HAWKGPU-0 AcceleratorDomain. Coherence engine for copies inside a fabric.
tools/accelerator/humf.py / hmf.py.connected: MemoryClass drives lifted object-home placements (via fusion_planner.place_objects). Trust/state stay in HUMF; this lane does not reimplement the coherence engine. DomainVisibility is a separate readback vs device-compute axis.

tools/accelerator/machine_genome.py.provided: Physical identity of this machine: sysctl facts, optional measured bandwidth inside a protected window, ABSENT-with-reason for missing fields.
tools/accelerator/machine_genome.py.connected: domain_from_machine_genome reads memory_bytes already recorded. Does not call measure_bandwidth().

tools/odyssey/device_profiles.py.provided: INTERACTIVE (one-stream TPOT) and MAXX (four-stream aggregate tps) workload profiles. Not device domains.
tools/odyssey/device_profiles.py.connected: Placement.profile_hint admits exactly those two names. They are not treated as execution domains.

tools/future/hwir.py.provided: FPGA IR: node kinds including dma-transport, HwirEdge with in-transit transforms, DeviceBudget declared_not_measured, PRIMITIVE_TO_NODE_KIND['SemanticTransportEdge']='dma-transport', validator that rejects source-tensor identity.
tools/future/hwir.py.connected: lower_fpga_domain_to_hwir emits dma-transport nodes whose primitive is the existing atlas name SemanticTransportEdge. This is the same primitive, not a second one. DeviceBudget.declared_not_measured remains True.

tools/accelerator/architecture_atlas.py.provided: PRIMITIVES includes SemanticTransportEdge as a backend-neutral name.
tools/accelerator/architecture_atlas.py.connected: semantic_transport.ATLAS_PRIMITIVE is that same string; a test pins equality with atlas.PRIMITIVES and hwir.PRIMITIVE_TO_NODE_KIND.

added.tools/accelerator/semantic_transport.py: ExecutionDomain (DomainKind GPU_UMA/CPU/NPU/FPGA_HBM), DomainVisibility (readback vs device_compute with evidence), CoherencyAssumption ladder including explicit NONE, SemanticTransportEdge (source, destination, payload semantics, ownership transfer, sync requirement, coherency_assumption, link_coherency, COST_MODEL cost, in-transit transforms). Cost construction refuses any label other than COST_MODEL.
added.tools/accelerator/placement.py: Node-to-domain Placement (COMPUTATION/STATE/STORAGE) with ResourceRequirements and ValidityCondition. Distinct from fusion_planner.Placement (object-home). No product branch; kind_admits is uniformly True.
added.tools/accelerator/fusion_bridge.py: HeterogeneousPlan, validate/compose, two_domain_plan (host GPU_UMA + declared FPGA_HBM, non-coherent link), overlay_physical_graph, plan_to_timeline, lower_fpga_domain_to_hwir, domain_from_machine_genome, lift_object_placements. Validator rejects COHERENCY_OVERCLAIM, HARDWARE_UMA_ACROSS_DOMAINS, READBACK_IS_NOT_COMPUTE_VISIBILITY, COST_LABEL_REFUSED, RESOURCES_EXCEED_CAPACITY.
added.tools/odyssey/fusion_bridge_adapter.py: annotate_compiler_output, physical_graph_with_bridge, overlay. Does not import physical_graph_compiler (avoids numpy/checkpoint path).
added.tools/accelerator/test_fusion_bridge.py: 26 pins including the mandatory negative coherency test, COST_MODEL labeling, vendor-control-flow AST scan, HWIR/PhysicalGraph/fusion_planner/fusion_isa/machine_genome/device_profiles connections.

tests.related: 267 passed (fusion_bridge + fusion_planner + fusion_isa + fusion_wire + hmf + humf + physical_graph_scoring)
tests.accelerator_minus_sparse_holes: 723 passed, 55 skipped. Ignored files need receipts/headless or live mlx/ps that this sparse worktree does not materialize (test_akb, test_bench, test_ccl, test_flash_meta_*, test_odyssey_pass, test_qwen27_token_budget, test_receipt_bench_corpus, test_repatriation_*). Those failures pre-exist this lane and were not recreated.
tests.full_pytest_tools_accelerator: 49 failed, 771 passed, 67 skipped. Every failure is a missing receipts/headless path, mlx, or sandbox-blocked ps -- not a fusion-bridge regression.
